title: Kodiak Power Cakes (Joe's Way: Whole Milk and Eggs)
description: Kodiak pancakes made with whole milk and an egg, never water. 1 cup mix makes about 8 to 10 medium pancakes (about 2 servings).
steps: Whisk the egg and 3/4 cup milk together. Stir in the mix until just combined. Lumps are fine.
Let sit 2 to 3 min (the batter thickens a little). Adjust: too thick to pour, add milk 1 Tbsp at a time up to 1 cup total. Too thin, a spoonful more mix.
Heat a skillet or griddle over medium. Light coat of butter.
Pour about 1/4 cup per pancake. Cook until bubbles form and edges look set, about 2 min.
Flip, cook 1 to 2 min more until golden. Turn heat down a notch if they brown before cooking through.
Serve with butter and real maple syrup, sausage links on the side.
source: Joe's Meal Pack, Oct 20 to Nov 4, 2026 (built by Thrifty, now kept by Meal Plan), R14
notes: Ingredients are per 1 cup mix. Double for two hungry people. Never water.

healthy: Kodiak mix is whole grain and higher in protein than regular pancake mix.
Egg and whole milk add more protein and calcium.
not_healthy: Butter and whole milk add saturated fat.
